content.comment_body: Hello, for my project I want to set up communication between a [product_name] and a [product_name] controller. Specifically, I'm looking to read inputs or various blocks from [product_name], process this data in the [product_name] controller, and then trigger outputs on the [product_name]. Is this possible, and if so, what is the recommended approach?
Hi, Have you checked this FAQ: [document] - Connection between [product_name] Client and [product_name] Server? It could be helpful.
Yes, this is achievable. You might also want to review the discussion on how to communicate [product_name] controller with [product_name] PLC.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking to set up communication between two different [company_name] controllers to read inputs and process data, then trigger outputs accordingly. The community confirms this integration is possible and points to documentation and previous forum threads for further information, but does not outline detailed configuration steps. The main insight is a need for clear instructions and confirmation that such interoperability between these devices can be accomplished.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to create straightforward, two-way communication between both [product_name] devices to read and control signals, ideally with clear guidance or practical examples.
